youtube_description:
I recently showed you a demo of how my Unity AI Museum worked with a long form YouTube video in which many of you found very useful and also sent me great comments, today I like to show you a few more AI prompts I generated with OpenAI Dalle2 inside of Unity. 

What AI and XR technology was used with this demo?
- Unity XR Toolkit (for VR interactions)
- OpenAI Dalle2 API (for AI image generation)
- Meta Voice SDK (for voice to text generation)
